description_en: Changes the configuration of one or more Mongos or shard nodes in an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 变更云数据库MongoDB分片集群实例中一个或多个Mongos节点、Shard节点的配置
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-node-spec-batch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-bp1337621e8f0000 --nodes-info Shards_:_DBInstanceClass_:_dds.shard.mid_,_DBInstanceName_:_d-bp14ae4572fd0000_,_Storage_:20_,_DBInstanceClass_:_dds.shard.mid_,_DBInstanceName_:_d-bp19f4f92dc50000_,_Storage_:30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNodeSpecBatch

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance for which you want to change configurations
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行变更配置的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance types of the Mongos and shard nodes that you want to change. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要变配的Mongos节点、Shard节点的规格信息。具体规格请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html
parameters.name: nodes_info

parameters.help_en: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

<props="china">

false: Manual payment is enabled. Log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs. In the navigation pane on the left, choose Subscription Orders > My Orders. On the Product Orders tab, find the target order and pay for it.

</props>


<props="intl">

false: Manual payment is enabled. Log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs. In the navigation pane on the left, click Order Management. On the Product Orders page, find the target order and pay for it.

</props>


Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：
true：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

默认值为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The effective period of the configuration change. Valid values:

Immediately: The change takes effect immediately.

MaintainTime: The change takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62008.html operation to change the maintenance window of an instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to view the maintenance window of an instance.

Default value: Immediately
parameters.help_zh:
变更配置的生效时间，取值：

Immediately：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可维护时间段内生效。

您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62008.html修改实例的可维护时间段。
您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html查看实例可维护时间段时间。

默认为Immediately
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of configuration change. Valid values:

UPGRADE: Upgrades the instance configuration.

DOWNGRADE: Downgrades the instance configuration.

This parameter is available only when the billing method of the instance is subscription
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值：

UPGRADE：升级配置。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

当实例付费方式为包年包月时，该参数可用
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

default or null (default): A coupon is used.

youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: A coupon is not used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination virtual switch for a configuration change that involves a zone migration.

<notice>

This parameter applies only to instances that use disks.

</notice>

This parameter is required only for a configuration change that involves a zone migration
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配的目标虚拟交换机ID。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone of the hidden node for a configuration change that involves a zone migration.

<notice>

This parameter applies only to instances that use disks.

</notice>

<notice>

The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetSecondaryZoneId parameter.

</notice>

This parameter is required only for a configuration change that involves a zone migration
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，隐藏节点（Hidden节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetSecondaryZoneId参数值相同。></notice>


只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_hidden_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone of the primary node for a configuration change that involves a zone migration.

<notice>

This parameter applies only to instances that use disks.

</notice>

<notice>

The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetSecondaryZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.

</notice>

This parameter is required only for a configuration change that involves a zone migration
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，主节点（Primary节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetSecondaryZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone of the secondary node for a configuration change that involves a zone migration.

<notice>

This parameter applies only to instances that use disks.

</notice>

<notice>

The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.

</notice>

This parameter is required only for a configuration change that involves a zone migration
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，从节点（Secondary节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_secondary_zone_id
